statusDetail: Coverage-complete multi-template audit. The required age-assurance UI obscured screenshots, but rendered DOM and objective probes remained available; no check was omitted.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-page site with legacy/custom JavaScript components
page.notes: Adult media/catalog site with listing, search, model, localized and video-detail templates. Initial visual state is a third-party age-assurance overlay.

findings.summary: No user-preference dark theme
findings.evidence: The dark/reduced screenshot is visually identical to the light capture; the computed body remains rgb(255,255,255), color-scheme is normal, and CSS inspection found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not handled
findings.evidence: Under prefers-contrast: more, controls retain normal colors and CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules; axe also found 16 contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations, preserving visible borders, focus, and system colors.

findings.summary: Route and state changes lack View Transitions
findings.evidence: The CSS feature probe found no view-transition rules on this multi-page site.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document view transitions for same-origin navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: The homepage main content is over 10,000px tall, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state queries or progress treatment and the rendered chrome is static.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact scroll-aware header or progress affordance without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Menus use hand-wired positioning rather than anchored primitives
findings.evidence: The DOM uses data-popover controls while CSS inspection found no anchor-name or position-anchor support.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for menus near viewport edges.

findings.summary: Navigation changes do not cue moved attention
findings.evidence: No View Transition, highlight, or comparable attention-guidance rules were found across listing, search and detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional transitions and focus/highlight cues after navigation while honoring reduced motion.

findings.summary: Third-party interruptions dominate entry
findings.evidence: The initial screenshot is fully obscured by an age-verification overlay, while page scripts also include popunder and smartpop advertising integrations. Age assurance is necessary, but unrelated popunder behavior is not.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the required age gate focused and remove automatic popunder/smartpop interruptions; defer promotional surfaces until an explicit user action.

findings.summary: The age gate and menus are custom overlay structures
findings.evidence: The active page overlay is a fixed fancybox div and the DOM contains no dialog or popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the age gate as a modal dialog and transient menus with popover, including focus trapping, return, and declarative dismissal.

findings.summary: Promotional chrome crowds the content experience
findings.evidence: The rendered homepage includes a premium banner, six affiliate links, multiple live/ad placements and 345 interactive elements before/around a 10,000px content feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent promotional chrome and make editorial/media content the dominant hierarchy.

findings.summary: Reusable cards are not container-responsive
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules despite card components appearing across homepage, listing, search and detail templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/grid components containment and size-aware container query variants.

findings.summary: Touch and zoom affordances are restricted
findings.evidence: The target probe found 106 visible controls below 44px, including three 28x28 header buttons; axe reports the viewport disables user scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase icon-button hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS px, retain visible focus, and remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is extremely slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 21.04s, FCP 2.82s and Speed Index 12.31s, producing a 0.59 performance score; the trace corroborates a much faster gate paint, showing the full content load is the expensive state.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP resource and prevent below-gate media/ads from competing before age verification and user intent.

findings.summary: Images do not reserve layout space
findings.evidence: All 90 inspected images lack width/height attributes and mobile observed CLS reached 0.09375.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every media card and reserve ad/player slots.

findings.summary: Initial delivery is excessively heavy
findings.evidence: The HAR captured 139 requests and 9.20MB transferred, including 6.25MB images, 2.00MB XHR/media and six parser-blocking stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate nonessential media and ads, consolidate critical CSS, lazy-load below-fold assets, and set intentional cache policies.

findings.summary: Unused and third-party code inflate startup
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 338KiB unused JavaScript and 39KiB unused CSS; the HAR records 80 third-party requests and 2.69MB third-party transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused legacy libraries, route-split behavior, and load advertising/analytics only after consent and need.

findings.summary: Many controls and media lack accessible names
findings.evidence: axe found critical unnamed header buttons, 20 unnamed links, one missing image alternative and three untitled frames.
findings.suggestedFix: Add concise accessible names, useful iframe titles and correct decorative/meaningful image alternatives.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG AA
findings.evidence: axe found 16 serious contrast failures, including 14px navigation links at 3.2:1 where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and verify in normal and high-contrast modes.

findings.summary: Landmark and page-heading structure is inconsistent
findings.evidence: axe found content outside landmarks; the homepage content headings precede the age-gate H1, and the detail page has an empty heading followed by promotional model headings.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one meaningful page H1, logical heading order, and contain all primary content in named landmarks.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled
findings.evidence: The viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=0; axe classifies this as critical.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom and 200% text zoom; re-test reflow and target sizing at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Image assets are not soundly dimensioned or modernized
findings.evidence: The image audit found 90/90 without explicit dimensions, 40 oversized, 66 without srcset and 43 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit dimensions and responsive AVIF/WebP sources sized to card breakpoints.

findings.summary: The page is blocked from the back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons centered on Cache-Control: no-store and a JavaScript request receiving no-store.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid blanket no-store on public pages and isolate truly sensitive responses so back/forward navigation can restore instantly.

findings.summary: Some navigation targets are not crawlable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found five non-crawlable anchors; the DOM also includes a Go Premium href ending in #.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real destination URLs for navigation and buttons for actions; retain descriptive link text.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks organization/site structured data
findings.evidence: Open Graph is present and the detail template has VideoObject JSON-LD, but the homepage contains no JSON-LD describing the site/organization.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate WebSite/Organization JSON-LD and keep the existing VideoObject metadata aligned with visible detail content.

findings.summary: CSP and cookie protections are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS are present, but CSP is absent; PHPSESSID is not Secure or HttpOnly, and kt_acctoken uses SameSite=None without HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP and mark session/auth-like cookies Secure, HttpOnly and Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The page sends data across a broad third-party ad/tracking surface
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found 15 third-party origins including Google Analytics; HAR recorded 80 third-party requests and 2.69MB before gate completion.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize vendors, require explicit contextual consent, and defer analytics/ad requests until consent and purpose are established.

findings.summary: Account surfaces do not expose modern phishing-resistant authentication
findings.evidence: The site exposes profile/account and subscription controls, but rendered source contains no WebAuthn/passkey integration; Lighthouse confirms no permission prompts on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside recovery, and keep permission requests tied to user actions.

findings.summary: Browser policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: HSTS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN and same-origin referrer policy are present, but CSP and Permissions-Policy are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive Permissions-Policy and CSP frame-ancestors; consider Trusted Types for script-heavy authenticated surfaces.

findings.summary: Runtime behavior relies on fragile custom overlays and no-store navigation
findings.evidence: Menus use custom data-popover wiring, the age gate is a fixed fancybox overlay, and Lighthouse reports BFCache blocking.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt native dialog/popover behavior, sequence optional dependencies, and restore BFCache eligibility.

findings.summary: The installable manifest is not backed by an offline runtime
findings.evidence: A standalone manifest with icons/start_url exists, but the service-worker controller probe is false.
findings.suggestedFix: If installability is intentional, add a minimal service worker and offline fallback; otherwise remove misleading standalone-app signals.

findings.summary: Localized pages declare the wrong document language
findings.evidence: The Spanish route renders Spanish navigation and pricing but html lang remains en; CSS inspection found 329 physical-direction declarations and only one logical-property signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang per locale and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties, testing RTL expansion.

findings.summary: Aggressive affiliate and popunder behavior undermines predictable choice
findings.evidence: The page loads popunder/smartpop scripts and presents many external affiliate destinations around core navigation before the user clears age assurance.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove automatic popunders, clearly label sponsored destinations, and make refusal/continuation choices equally understandable.

findings.summary: Subscription commitments lack nearby cancellation context
findings.evidence: A four-option recurring upgrade form is injected on every audited template, but its DOM labels show price/term only and no nearby cancellation, renewal or reversal information.
findings.suggestedFix: Show renewal, total commitment, cancellation route and confirmation before selection and purchase.

findings.summary: Media assets are substantially over-delivered
findings.evidence: The image audit found 40 oversized images, 43 legacy-format images, 66 without responsive sources and no modern-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP variants and select by rendered size and density.

findings.summary: Heavy media work starts before the user reaches content
findings.evidence: HAR captured 62 XHR/fetch requests and about 2MB, largely live HLS segments, while an age gate obscured the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not start preview streams or background fetches until age verification, visibility and user intent justify them.

findings.summary: Third-party and autoplay media cost is disproportionate
findings.evidence: The HAR records 80 third-party requests/2.69MB; detail DOM contains four video elements, two autoplaying muted, with no tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Cap third-party budgets, replace autoplay previews with posters, and defer media until interaction/viewport entry.

findings.summary: Repeated menu interaction shows retained-growth risk
findings.evidence: After ten open/close cycles, heap summary size rose from 18.61MB/281,093 nodes to 22.22MB/315,989 nodes (about 19%/12%); separate browser sessions make this a low-confidence risk signal, not proof of a leak.
findings.suggestedFix: Re-run in one controlled session with forced GC and baseline/target/final snapshots; inspect retained listeners, closures and third-party widgets.

taskList.title: Stop pre-gate autoplay, popunders and nonessential third-party requests
Repair accessible names, contrast, zoom and touch target sizing
Add CSP, Permissions-Policy and secure cookie attributes
Replace custom overlays with dialog/popover and anchored positioning
Remove unused legacy bundles and recover BFCache eligibility
Correct localized lang and migrate to logical CSS properties
Add preference-driven dark and high-contrast themes
Make subscription commitments and sponsored destinations explicit
Improve crawlable links and homepage structured metadata
Add modern navigation transitions and attention cues
Run a controlled same-session memory leak investigation
